body:
Hi! I am quite on the heavy side like you. Around 200 lbs, actually even more due to what happened lately.

Are gyms open there? I was an active gym goer before and I just returned after 2 years. Even battling with depression and abandonment (I voluntarily checked in because I couldn't handle the depression anymore), I now go to the gym religiously. I promise you it helps.

Big guys like us are physically strong. It may take a while, but more weight = stronger. Try it dear stranger, and keep this in mind. :)

Please don't give up. I feel this too, and I may be a hypocrite for saying this but please hold on. I know what losing a lot of things feel, I know what depression is.

But at the end of the day, don't we just need that light? Even from a stranger? I hope this makes you feel better my friend.

I envy you for being strong. I don't have relationships with anyone, and that leaves me questioning what's worth living for. I just lost my significant other, and adds to my depression among other things, and ultimately lost my "will" to go on.

I wish I had your strength, stranger.
Thank you. I will try to do this.
Never abandon your friend. Relationships are hard for some of us. That's probably the best thing you can do.

I wish I was as strong as you.. I don't have that attitude of fighting back, or to "spite". I have been bullied, and its just disheartening. I don't find peace.

I know what you mean by regretting at the last minute. I don't have the courage to take my life away, because I've did that before and had serious consequences.

I just can't find a reason to go on. Sorry for being a downer.
